_readme: Risk rules for the paper engine. Same discipline as the shadow's
shadow-thresholds.json: every value carries its own rationale, the file
carries a version, and nothing here is fitted to observed outcomes.
These are MVP rules set A PRIORI from the account definition (100 USDC,
no leverage, no naked shorts). They are not claimed optimal, and tuning
them on results the rules will later be judged against is how a strategy
is invented rather than found. A change must bump `version` and be
basis: a priori: 100 USDC virtual account, no leverage, no naked shorts; per-opportunity and per-market caps sized so a full day of signals cannot exhaust the account in one trade

max_opportunity_fraction.unit: fraction of initial capital per opportunity
max_opportunity_fraction.rationale: One opportunity may commit at most 10% of opening capital (10 USDC at 100). Sized against the account, not the market: the point is that no single signal can dominate the ledger, whatever its edge claims.

max_market_exposure_fraction.unit: fraction of initial capital per market (cumulative)
max_market_exposure_fraction.rationale: All open positions in one market together may occupy at most 20% of opening capital (20 USDC at 100). Cumulative, not per-fill: multiple episodes in the same market accumulate toward one cap, so a market cannot be climbed by repeated small buys.
